## Summary

- What changed?
- Which module/owner is affected?

## Integration checks

- [ ] I worked on a feature branch from `develop`.
- [ ] I did not commit `.env`, credentials, databases, or private datasets.
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`PYTHONPATH=backend python -m pytest -q backend/tests`).
- [ ] Frontend build passes (`npm ci && npm run build` in `frontend/`).
- [ ] API/schema changes are documented and coordinated with dependent members.
- [ ] No fake/static values are presented as real model or database results.
- [ ] Risk findings are described as signals for human review, not proof of fraud.

Add evidence when the UI or API changes.
